mcq_fix.s: Consider the following statements: I. The Zilla-bandi or Zila Bandi system was introduced by Salarjung in 1865 in Hyderabad State. II. The Permanent Settlement, introduced by Lord Cornwallis, was extended to the North Sarkar region in 1802. III. Mulki conditions were issued in 1888 during the reign of the 6th Nizam, Mir Mahboob Ali Khan. IV. The resolution on linguistic reorganisation of states was moved by B.N. Sarma in 1918 in the Imperial Legislative Council. Which of the statements given above are correct?
mcq_fix.why: Central Legislative Assembly did not exist in 1918; B.N. Sarma moved it in the Imperial Legislative Council
